resources.string: When enabled, dated ingredients appear in expiry order. Items without an expiry date appear last. Otherwise, the pantry is sorted alphabetically. This preference is saved on this device.

Smart Pantry Manager
Java and SQLite

Recipe suggestions check ingredient names, quantities and compatible units. Expiry dates help you organise your pantry; they do not certify food safety or automatically exclude ingredients.

All pantry data stays on this device.
